package task

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"reflect"
	"strings"
	"testing"

	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain/repository"
)

type starterTaskRepo struct {
	repository.TaskRepository
	task   *domain.Task
	err    error
	events *[]string
}

func (repo starterTaskRepo) Get(context.Context, string) (*domain.Task, error) {
	*repo.events = append(*repo.events, "task.get")
	return repo.task, repo.err
}

type starterFilesRepo struct {
	files         []domain.TaskFileStorage
	replaceCalls  int
	replaceErrors map[int]error
	events        *[]string
}

func (repo *starterFilesRepo) ListByTask(context.Context, string) ([]domain.TaskFileStorage, error) {
	*repo.events = append(*repo.events, "files.list")
	return append([]domain.TaskFileStorage(nil), repo.files...), nil
}

func (repo *starterFilesRepo) ReplaceForTask(_ context.Context, _ string, files []domain.TaskFileStorage) error {
	repo.replaceCalls++
	*repo.events = append(*repo.events, "files.replace")
	if err := repo.replaceErrors[repo.replaceCalls]; err != nil {
		return err
	}
	repo.files = append([]domain.TaskFileStorage(nil), files...)
	return nil
}

type starterStorage struct {
	fileID      string
	uploadErr   error
	activateErr error
	activations int
	events      *[]string
}

func (storage *starterStorage) UploadStarterArchive(context.Context, string, string, []byte) (string, error) {
	*storage.events = append(*storage.events, "storage.upload")
	return storage.fileID, storage.uploadErr
}

func (storage *starterStorage) ActivateStarterArchive(context.Context, string) error {
	storage.activations++
	*storage.events = append(*storage.events, "storage.activate")
	return storage.activateErr
}

type starterTx struct {
	calls  int
	events *[]string
}

func (tx *starterTx) WithTx(ctx repository.Context, fn func(repository.Context) error) error {
	tx.calls++
	*tx.events = append(*tx.events, "tx.begin")
	if err := fn(ctx); err != nil {
		*tx.events = append(*tx.events, "tx.rollback")
		return err
	}
	*tx.events = append(*tx.events, "tx.commit")
	return nil
}

func TestUploadStarterArchiveCommitsBindingBeforeActivation(t *testing.T) {
	events := []string{}
	oldFiles := []domain.TaskFileStorage{{TaskID: "task-id", Type: domain.TaskFileStorageTypeStarterArchive, FileStorageID: "old-file", Order: 1}}
	files := &starterFilesRepo{files: oldFiles, events: &events}
	storage := &starterStorage{fileID: "new-file", events: &events}
	tx := &starterTx{events: &events}
	useCase := UploadStarterArchive{
		Tasks:     starterTaskRepo{task: &domain.Task{ID: "task-id"}, events: &events},
		TaskFiles: files,
		Uploader:  storage,
		Activator: storage,
		Tx:        tx,
	}

	result, err := useCase.Handle(context.Background(), UploadStarterArchiveInput{
		TaskID:           "task-id",
		OriginalFilename: "starter.zip",
		ArchiveData:      []byte("archive"),
	})

	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("upload failed: %v", err)
	}
	if len(result.StarterFiles) != 1 || result.StarterFiles[0].FileStorageID != "new-file" {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected result: %#v", result)
	}
	if len(files.files) != 1 || files.files[0].FileStorageID != "new-file" || tx.calls != 1 || storage.activations != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected state: files=%#v tx=%d activations=%d", files.files, tx.calls, storage.activations)
	}
	wantEvents := []string{"task.get", "storage.upload", "tx.begin", "files.list", "files.replace", "tx.commit", "storage.activate"}
	if !reflect.DeepEqual(events, wantEvents) {
		t.Fatalf("events=%v, want %v", events, wantEvents)
	}
}

func TestUploadStarterArchiveRestoresPreviousBindingWhenActivationFails(t *testing.T) {
	events := []string{}
	activationErr := errors.New("filestorage unavailable")
	oldFiles := []domain.TaskFileStorage{{TaskID: "task-id", Type: domain.TaskFileStorageTypeStarterArchive, FileStorageID: "old-file", Order: 1}}
	files := &starterFilesRepo{files: oldFiles, events: &events}
	storage := &starterStorage{fileID: "new-file", activateErr: activationErr, events: &events}
	tx := &starterTx{events: &events}
	useCase := UploadStarterArchive{
		Tasks:     starterTaskRepo{task: &domain.Task{ID: "task-id"}, events: &events},
		TaskFiles: files,
		Uploader:  storage,
		Activator: storage,
		Tx:        tx,
	}

	result, err := useCase.Handle(context.Background(), UploadStarterArchiveInput{TaskID: "task-id", ArchiveData: []byte("archive")})

	if result != nil || !errors.Is(err, activationErr) {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected result=%#v err=%v", result, err)
	}
	if len(files.files) != 1 || files.files[0].FileStorageID != "old-file" || tx.calls != 2 {
		t.Fatalf("previous binding was not restored: files=%#v tx=%d", files.files, tx.calls)
	}
	wantEvents := []string{
		"task.get", "storage.upload",
		"tx.begin", "files.list", "files.replace", "tx.commit",
		"storage.activate",
		"tx.begin", "files.replace", "tx.commit",
	}
	if !reflect.DeepEqual(events, wantEvents) {
		t.Fatalf("events=%v, want %v", events, wantEvents)
	}
}

func TestUploadStarterArchiveLeavesTemporaryFileUnactivatedWhenBindingFails(t *testing.T) {
	events := []string{}
	replaceErr := errors.New("replace failed")
	files := &starterFilesRepo{
		files:         []domain.TaskFileStorage{{FileStorageID: "old-file"}},
		replaceErrors: map[int]error{1: replaceErr},
		events:        &events,
	}
	storage := &starterStorage{fileID: "new-file", events: &events}
	useCase := UploadStarterArchive{
		Tasks:     starterTaskRepo{task: &domain.Task{ID: "task-id"}, events: &events},
		TaskFiles: files,
		Uploader:  storage,
		Activator: storage,
		Tx:        &starterTx{events: &events},
	}

	_, err := useCase.Handle(context.Background(), UploadStarterArchiveInput{TaskID: "task-id", ArchiveData: []byte("archive")})

	if !errors.Is(err, replaceErr) || storage.activations != 0 || files.files[0].FileStorageID != "old-file" {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected failure state: err=%v activations=%d files=%#v", err, storage.activations, files.files)
	}
	if strings.Join(events, ",") != "task.get,storage.upload,tx.begin,files.list,files.replace,tx.rollback" {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected events: %v", events)
	}
}

func TestUploadStarterArchiveRequiresLifecycleDependencies(t *testing.T) {
	events := []string{}
	useCase := UploadStarterArchive{
		Tasks:     starterTaskRepo{task: &domain.Task{ID: "task-id"}, events: &events},
		TaskFiles: &starterFilesRepo{events: &events},
		Uploader:  &starterStorage{fileID: "new-file", events: &events},
	}

	if _, err := useCase.Handle(context.Background(), UploadStarterArchiveInput{TaskID: "task-id", ArchiveData: []byte("archive")}); !errors.Is(err, domain.ErrValidation) {
		t.Fatalf("missing lifecycle dependencies returned %v", err)
	}
}
